summary_claims.claim: Civil penalty of USD 1,000 per violation up to USD 500,000 per operator

note: Quotes match the enrolled Senate File 2417 and Iowa Acts chapter 1068 ('Approved May 2, 2026') and the bill history (effective 1 Jul 2026, applicability 1 Jul 2027). Status Adopted, not yet in force follows from Section 7, under which the Act applies from 1 Jul 2027. The search found no amendment; one secondary source gives 3 May for the signing, against the official 2 May.
